<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Generate projects and code from versioned, updatable packs, for humans and AI agents.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`add`](/reference/cli/add/) | Generate a piece, e.g. `cuilo add ui/atom Button`. |
| [`adopt`](/reference/cli/adopt/) | Take over existing code as a piece, so later updates merge into it; existing files are kept. |
| [`update`](/reference/cli/update/) | Update everything generated from a pack, merging your edits. |
| [`status`](/reference/cli/status/) | Show every generated file and whether it is clean, modified or missing. |
| [`why`](/reference/cli/why/) | Explain where a line of a generated file comes from, e.g. `cuilo why src/a.ts:12`. |
| [`log`](/reference/cli/log/) | List the transactions that can be undone. |
| [`undo`](/reference/cli/undo/) | Undo the last transaction. |
| [`detect`](/reference/cli/detect/) | Show the project's detected stack. |
| [`trust`](/reference/cli/trust/) | Let cuilo run this project's own formatters and linters, such as Biome, on generated files. |
| [`pack`](/reference/cli/pack/) | Work with packs. |
| [`completions`](/reference/cli/completions/) | Print a shell completion script, e.g. `cuilo completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_cuilo`. |
| [`upgrade`](/reference/cli/upgrade/) | Upgrade cuilo to the newest release, with the package manager that installed it, if any. |
| [`mcp`](/reference/cli/mcp/) | Serve cuilo to AI agents over MCP (stdio) |

## Global options

These work with every command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--root <ROOT>` | Project root; defaults to the current folder. |
| `--json` | Print JSON instead of text. |
| `--no-input` | Never ask questions; fail instead when something is missing. |

## Exit codes

See [Exit codes](/reference/exit-codes/).
